direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Text band, then sheet
hero.blueprint: A black or white field on a seven-column grid with 14px margins and 14px gaps. There is no display type: everything is set at one size, 16px, in one weight. The top band is plain text hanging from a line 20px below the top edge: the name in column one; one sentence on availability in column two; a list of five or six services from column three; a longer list of clients or awards from column five; and two links, profile and the single contact action, at the right end of column seven. Lists run one item per line. Below the lists about 300px of ground is left empty. At mid-height the sheet begins: one thumbnail per column, each the full column width (about 190px) at its natural ratio, top-aligned, with the project title in the text size above the first frame of each run of two to four frames. Rows continue below the fold with 40px between them. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border and no caption on the image.
hero.mobile: The grid becomes two columns with 12px gaps. The name and the availability sentence take the top; services and clients sit side by side under them as two short lists at 15px. An 80px gap follows, then the sheet: two frames per row at natural ratios, each project title above its first frame. The contact action is a text link fixed bottom-right.
hero.headline: None at display size: the name is set at 16px with the rest of the text, and one sentence of up to 60 characters says what the person does.

type.note: A narrow, sharp display serif for headlines against a small plain sans: a five-to-one jump with nothing between. Suits agencies, bakeries and restaurants, fashion and editorial brands.

palette.name: Forest and lime
palette.note: Forest green, black and white sections alternate, with forest green holding the most; photographs stay in moss greens and stone browns. Pale lime sits on small squares only, such as arrow buttons and the closing wordmark.

motion.name: Index with preview
motion.description: Rows of text are the navigation through the work; pointing at a row brings up its image in one fixed frame and dims the other rows. On touch screens each row shows its image inline instead. Fast and exact (about 240ms crossfade), no lag behind the pointer. Recipe: 'Index with preview, anchored to the row' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Full-bleed sequence, text interlocked
sections.blueprint: Three photographs, each 100vw by 100svh, shown one after another with nothing between them. Each is `position: sticky; top: 0` inside a wrapper 300svh tall, so the second slides up over the first and the third over the second like a curtain; no scroll hijacking. The section above interlocks with the first photograph: a narrow paragraph at 13–14px, 220px wide, sitting on the column line at 58% of the width, is pulled down with a negative bottom margin so its last four lines overlap the photograph's top edge, in a colour that reads on both ground and image. Each photograph carries one caption line at 15px in white at the bottom-left margin, over a neutral dark scrim limited to the lowest 120px. No heading. Choose three frames with the same light and a calm lower-left corner. The last photograph releases into the next section.
sections.mobile: Each photograph is 100vw by 88svh in a portrait crop and still sticks so the next covers it. The interlocking paragraph sits at the left margin, 60% wide, overlapping the first photograph by three lines. Captions stay bottom-left at 14px.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

sections.name: Full panels, one midline row
sections.blueprint: Four to seven consecutive panels, each 100vw by 100svh, butted together with no gap. Each panel is one photograph of the project cropped much tighter than its frame (`object-fit: cover` with the image scaled to 130%), so a detail fills the screen. The same three-part text row sits at exactly 50% of the height on every panel, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` or over a neutral dark scrim band 90px tall: the date or year at the left margin at 15px, the project title in capitals at clamp(22px, 2vw, 30px) starting 10% in from the left, and one fact (location, client, number of pieces) at the right margin at 15px. Because the row never moves, scrolling reads like turning plates in a book. Panels may be `position: sticky; top: 0` so each slides over the last. There is no section heading; the first panel's title row is the heading.
sections.mobile: Panels are 100vw by 82svh. The row drops to the bottom of each panel, 20px above its edge: the title at 22px on the first line, then date at the left and fact at the right on a second line at 13px, over the same scrim band.

sections.name: A plain sentence, one action
sections.blueprint: The page ends on an almost empty screen. On the page ground, with no band and no panel, one sentence of eight to fourteen words is set at 18–22px in the regular weight, in the full ink, no wider than 34ch, on the same left edge as the page's text column (or centred only if the whole page is centred). 24px beneath it sits one small filled button, about 40px tall with 18px side padding, and optionally one text link beside it on the same baseline. That is all. Above the sentence leave at least 30svh of empty ground and below it at least 20svh before the footer line, so the emptiness reads as decided. The sentence is written as something a person would say, and it names the action plainly. No headline-sized type appears anywhere in this section.
sections.mobile: Identical in spirit: the sentence at 18px with 20px margins, the button beneath at its natural width (not full width), 44px tall. Keep 20svh of empty ground above the sentence and 14svh below the button, before the footer line.

sections.name: Name across the last photograph
sections.blueprint: The footer is the page's last photograph, full-bleed at 100vw by 100svh, darkened evenly with `filter: brightness(0.62)` so paper-coloured type reads everywhere on it. Three layers of text sit on the image. Top row, 32px from the edge: a short link list at 16px at the left margin and contact details at the right margin, each no wider than three columns. Mid-height is left to the photograph. Along the bottom, the wordmark runs the full width in the paper colour, letters about 12–20vw tall depending on the name's length, baseline 56px above the edge; under it one line of legal text at 13px. Choose an image whose interest is in its middle band, since the top and bottom carry text. No panel, no box and no colour block separates the footer from the image: the photograph is the footer.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 88svh, cropped to its strongest vertical slice. Links stack at the top-left at 16px, contact beneath them. The wordmark is fitted to the width along the bottom, with the legal line under it at 12px.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

references.name: Deeo Studio
references.idea: The studio's four letters as huge extruded iridescent 3D blocks tumbling across a black stage, with a quiet ultralight serif statement underneath.
references.hero: Near-black viewport. Four extruded 3D letters, each roughly 45-60% of the viewport tall, are scattered at different depths and tilts across the top 80% of the screen: one cropped by the top-left corner, one lower and left of centre, a larger one upper-right, the last cropped by the right edge. Faces are dark glass; edges catch lilac, orange and holographic rainbow light. Over them runs a slim nav: bold caps wordmark top-left at a 60px margin, three small caps links (one with a tiny yellow tag) and an outlined rounded button top-right. Bottom-left, a light serif headline at about 72px begins and is cut by the fold after two lines.
references.type: PP Editorial New Ultralight for the statement headline at about 5vw; PP Neue Montreal Book, Medium and Bold for nav, caps labels and project titles; Inter 14px body. A bold Neue Montreal line reaches 160px (11.1vw) lower on the page. Light serif against bold grotesk is the pairing.
references.colour: #0d0d0d #ffffff #b79cf0 #ff5a1f #f5f5f5 #f0e68c — Near-black page with white type; colour comes from iridescent lilac, orange and rainbow reflections on the 3D letters and from each case-study thumbnail's own palette. The digest records one light grey section.
references.imagery: Extruded glassy letterforms with holographic edge light on black; case studies as square-cornered wide video thumbnails in each client's colours on a two-column grid; one tilted old snapshot in the footer.
references.layout: Side margins of 60px. After the hero come a small left-aligned paragraph and a caps label, then a work list that opens with one full-width thumbnail and continues as two columns with staggered vertical offsets. Every item repeats the same caption row. The footer is centred.

sections.description: The serif headline finishes just below the fold at top-left. Beneath it sits a four-line 17px grotesk paragraph in a column only about 190px wide (13% of the viewport), left-aligned at the margin, followed by roughly 120px of empty black and a tiny caps section label. The right three-quarters of the screen stay completely empty.

The first project is a single thumbnail running margin to margin; the rest sit in two columns with a 14px gutter, the right column offset vertically so thumbnails never align in rows. Under each thumbnail: project name in 16px medium at left with a line of tiny grey caps disciplines beneath, and a small outlined rounded button right-aligned on the same row. Square image corners, no card containers.

A tilted, slightly warped 1990s snapshot with a year caption overlaps giant block letters of the studio name set in dark grey barely lighter than the background, each letter several hundred pixels tall. Below, a centred row of five small links and a single centred line of the light serif at about 28px with a tiny speaker icon.

steal: Render the studio name as separate 3D letters at different depths and tilts, cropped by the viewport edges, instead of a flat wordmark.
Pair the loud hero object with an ultralight serif statement at bottom-left and a deliberately tiny, narrow paragraph, leaving most of the next screen empty.
Caption every work thumbnail with the same two-ended row: name and disciplines left, small outlined button right.

references.name: Decathlon Yestalgia
references.idea: A full-commitment late-80s Memphis pastiche: sticker shapes with hard black shadows, ultra-condensed capitals and a glitching wordmark that flips nostalgia from no to yes.
references.hero: Pale grey page. A portrait video card, 35% of the width and 75% of the height with square corners, sits dead centre showing a hand on a boombox; across its middle a slanted, extruded gradient wordmark is caught mid-glitch and overhangs the card's left edge. Five flat sticker shapes with speckle patterns and solid black offset shadows are scattered in the empty flanks: pink arc upper-left, lime lightning bolt lower-left, orange disc upper-right, blue arch lower-right, a teal triangle cropped by the top edge. The header is inset 8%: a chunky lime menu button left, the retro logo centred, language selector and shop button right, all with hard black shadows.
references.type: Roboto Flex throughout, pushed to its narrowest, heaviest setting for uppercase headlines at about 14vw with tight leading; 12–16px medium uppercase for buttons. Campaign wordmarks are custom lettering: slanted, extruded and gradient-filled.
references.colour: #f4f4f4 #eaa0cd #e9dae6 #d9e13f #0a0809 #f0923a — Starts neutral grey, shifts to pale pink then saturated bubblegum pink on scroll. Lime marks every control; orange, sky blue, green and purple appear in illustrations, always outlined in black.
references.imagery: Sun-drenched lifestyle video and photos (older skaters, a boombox) alongside thick-outlined cartoon illustration, palm trees, a striped sunset and speckled geometric stickers; photos appear as tilted white-bordered prints overlapping headlines.
references.layout: A centred axis for media and headlines with decoration scattered in the margins and cropped by viewport edges. Each scroll stage changes background colour and adds a pattern (grid paper, stripes, perspective grid). Headlines stay put while pictures and characters pass over them.

sections.description: Pale pink with faint grid-paper lines. A two-line ultra-condensed black headline, each line about 14vw tall, sits centre-left and takes 40% of the width. Decoration crowds the lower half: an orange half-sun with palm trees rising at the right, a pink speckled arc and a cartoon character peeking from the bottom-left, a four-point sparkle upper-left. White horizontal stripes of increasing thickness run across the bottom edge as the hand-off to the next colour.

Bubblegum pink. A cartoon skater riding a cassette tape, with chrome numerals and a lightning bolt behind, is placed centre-right at about 40% of the viewport height and overlaps the headline. The three-line condensed headline is distorted mid-scroll: its second and third lines sink and shear toward the lower right as if printed on a curling poster. Pink and white stripe bands cap the top.

Same pink field. A small condensed line is centred above the giant two-line headline. Two portrait photographs with thin white borders, each roughly 380×510px, are dropped on top of the headline's centre, tilted about −8 and +6 degrees and overlapping each other, hiding half the letters. One orange speckled disc sits alone at the right; a lime bolt is cropped by the top-left corner.

Pink field overlaid with a white wireframe grid plane tilted in perspective. A pennant-shaped campaign logo in purple, green, pink and yellow sits at centre; sticker shapes are pinned to the corners and cut off by the viewport; two 10px legal links are centred at the very bottom. There are no link columns at all.

steal: Give every control and sticker a solid black offset shadow instead of a blurred one so flat shapes feel like die-cut objects.
Start the hero video as a centred portrait card surrounded by scattered shapes, then scale it to full-bleed on first scroll.
Drop tilted, white-bordered photos directly on top of a giant condensed headline so the type becomes background.
references.media: A centred portrait video window of about 506x674 covers about 26% of the fold, with flat stickers in the corners, and opens to full bleed by clip-path over an 1800px runway, so by the second screen the video covers the whole screen. Later: an illustration scene rising over a statement, tilted photos rising over a headline, an edge-to-edge product grid of 3-up and 4-up rows mixing stills and 2-4s loops, a carousel of tilted portrait videos and a name index scrolling past a held square picture; 36 pictures and 16 muted looping videos, no radius.
references.motion: No preloader: the montage cuts through four shots in 4.5s while the half-ring stickers turn, and Lenis then runs two sticky frames, the first opening the hero inset from about 26% per side to 0, the second raising an illustration scene over the statement as the ground switches from lavender to hot pink. Images reveal by clip-path over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1) with an inner image move on the same ease, statement characters fade and move over 1s, and UI moves at 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1).
